answer: Histories are stored in velvet, checked in sparrow, and horizon publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 40 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
